Resolves #20020

Repairs the post-drop settle boundary and partition oracle in `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationTabDragHeadersStayNL.spec.mjs` (`54652dbf26`). When `mouseup` ends the tab drag on `heavy-tabs`, `SortZone#processDragEnd` restores focus to the dragged button (`dragFocusOwner.focus`) and reveals the toolbar's `showOnFocus` contextual actions (`reload`, `lock`, `pop-out`), whose newly mounted DOM nodes register `ResizeObserver` via `initDomEvents()` and trigger `Overflow#onActionGeometryChange` (`project(false)`), narrowing the usable strip extent so `Overflow.computeOverflow` keeps the 2 protected tabs (`activeItemId` + `focusedItemId`) and displaces the 3rd into the overflow menu. The spec now polls (`expect.poll`, no fixed timeout) until `SortZone` clears inline positioning, focus restoration mounts the contextual action buttons in the DOM, `Overflow` is idle (`!sortDragProjectionQueued && !sortDragDrainScheduled && !measuring && !projectQueued`), and the rendered tab button set across two consecutive animation frames and `appliedHiddenIds` match `Overflow.computeOverflow` for the measured focused extent, while preserving the mid-drag `>= 3`, `outsideFrames === []`, inline-position, and `height > 16` assertions.

Evidence: L3 (Playwright Whitebox E2E with Neural Link against live Workstation app at 54652dbf26) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-4).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | Outside-CI: `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationTabDragHeadersStayNL.spec.mjs` (`54652dbf26`) polls NL component/plugin state (`containsFocus`, `contextualActionsVisible`, `sortDragProjectionQueued`, `sortDragDrainScheduled`, `measuring`, `projectQueued`, `appliedHiddenIds`) and two consecutive `requestAnimationFrame` reads matching the focused-extent partition with zero `waitForTimeout` (`check-fixed-sleeps.mjs` green). |
| AC-2 | Outside-CI: `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationTabDragHeadersStayNL.spec.mjs` asserts rendered post-drop buttons equal `Overflow.computeOverflow` `visible` (`[activePreDragButton.id, targetButton.id]`), `appliedHiddenIds` equals `computedPartition.hidden` (containing `displacedPreDragButton.id`), the overflow menu items contain `displacedPreDragButton.text`, mid-drag frames keep `>= 3` buttons, `outsideFrames` is `[]`, inline position/left/top are `''`, and `postDropDragged.height > 16`. |
| AC-3 | Outside-CI diagonal: with a `150 ms` pause injected immediately after `page.mouse.up()`, unrepaired `dev` (`b0af996452`) fails at `Expected: >= 3, Received: 2`, and the repaired spec at head (`e0f46820ed`) passes (`1 passed (11.3s)`). |
| AC-4 | Outside-CI: standalone 3× run (`--repeat-each=3`) at `54652dbf26` → `3 passed (27.2s)` (`5.1s`, `4.6s`, `4.6s`); full single-worker `e2e/workstation` + `e2e/dashboard` run (`226` tests, `--workers=1`) → `✓ 193 [chromium] › test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationTabDragHeadersStayNL.spec.mjs:29:5 (2.2s)`. |

## Deltas from ticket
- In `expect.poll`, required the revealed contextual action buttons (`actionEls.length > 0`) and `Overflow.computeOverflow` for `focusedExtent` to match both `domSettle.visibleIds` and `overflowState.appliedHiddenIds`, because `Mixin.DomEvents#initDomEvents` defers `ResizeObserver` registration on newly mounted `showOnFocus` action nodes by `150 ms` after `SortZone#processDragEnd`'s initial `10 ms` post-drag drain.
- Stopped `window.__tabDragSampling = false` synchronously inside the `mouseup` capture listener, narrowed `dragActive` to `toolbar.style.position === 'relative' && target?.style.position === 'absolute'`, waited for `measuredControlWidth > 0` before `mousedown`, and set `mouseSensor.delay = 0` so post-`mouseup` VDOM teardown batches and `150 ms` `ResizeObserver` registration on loaded 2-vCPU CI runners cannot race `drag:start`.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge (per guide §7.1):** three, none blocking.

1. **The extent formula is duplicated, not read.** The spec derives `focusedExtent` from the DOM (`coordExtent` / `sizeExtent` / `min`) the way `Overflow#project` does at `Overflow.mjs:856–880`, but the engine's formula has grown an arm the copy does not carry: with `owner.showOnHover === true` the plugin reserves the withheld action cluster's span up front (#20011). `heavy-tabs` runs with the default, so the copy is right today; the day that strip opts into hover reveal, this oracle computes a different extent than the plugin and the test lies in the strict direction. The durable shape is a readable `extent` (or the last measured usable size) on the plugin, so the spec asks the engine for the number it used instead of recomputing it. `hypothesis — needs V-B-A before implementation`: I did not check whether the plugin already keeps that value under another name.
2. **`mouseSensor.delay = 0` changes the gesture.** Setting the main-thread sensor's delay to zero makes the drag arm on the first move, which is not the default user gesture the original arm reproduced. The body's reason (post-`mouseup` teardown racing `drag:start` on 2-vCPU runners) is sound for stability; the question is coverage of the default-delay path. `hypothesis — needs V-B-A`: a sibling tab-drag spec in the same directory keeps the default delay, so the default path stays witnessed. If none does, that is a follow-up, not a blocker.
3. **`globalThis.DOMRect ??= class DOMRect {}` outlives the test.** Playwright runs several spec files in one worker process at `--workers=1`, so the stub stays defined for later files in that worker. Nothing in the e2e tier reads `DOMRect` in Node today; it is a watch item, not a defect.
